notes: Clean lane: no new claims beyond the known ledger (many go-core defects in policy.go, git.go, registry.go, install_windows.go and main.go are already open there and were not re-reported). Most walk items target templates, server handlers, shell scripts and skills in other chunks; those groups were answered as out-of-chunk. Cross-chunk items for the station: (1) config.ExpandInstallMarkers expands only {{PEEK_CONTROL_PORT}} while sync_settings.sh also expands {{HOME}} and {{PEEK_MCP}} — whether the server's compare/revert path (internal/server, sectionOverridden/handleConfig) handles those elsewhere is unverifiable here. (2) evals nested EvalDir.Dir is built with filepath.Join(skill, name), so on Windows it carries a backslash; whether the server's eval artifact route treats Dir as a URL segment is unverifiable here (these evals changes also trace to no supplied spec, already covered by the known concept-audit INFO). (3) startPeek's unidentifiable-listener log names the address and probe error but not the expected claude/codex homes that correctness-155 asks the ERROR to name — judged too weak to file (log text only).
